# Team PR Review Topics

<!-- Generated by local/pr-review-distill on 2026-07-23. Editable by hand. -->
**Window:** 2026-01-23 → 2026-07-23 · **Repos:** BlazingSaddlesUI, ND-Dashboard, lci-dashboard-frontend, lci-e2e-testing, lci-mcp, mim-dashboard, mim-dashboard-api · **Corpus:** 1,550 comments → 1,258 atoms
**Not covered:** the UP repos (`up-hub`, `unified-platform-hub-api`, `up_boilerplate`) and the two infra repos. So this reflects MCM/LCI/MMM review habits, not the whole team's.

> Ranked by how often the topic is raised across all reviewers, not by who raised it. This is a distillation of what the team tends to ask for in review — a checklist, not an assessment of anyone's reviewing. Example quotes are attributed and linked so each topic can be checked against the real comment.

## 1. Extract duplicated logic & reuse shared abstractions  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  131 mentions across 5 repos
**What we look for:** Flag copy-pasted logic, near-identical components/methods, and hand-rolled code that duplicates an existing utility, formatter, hook, scope, or component. Ask whether the difference is small enough to collapse into one shared abstraction (e.g. pass the schema/control in as a prop). Prefer reusing what already exists over adding a parallel implementation.
**Examples:**
- "We look up the advertiser 3 times with the same code. Could this be extracted?" — tseitz, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6145#discussion_r2925105292))
- "This decorator repeats the majority of the metrics from the report_decorator, should we extract them to a module?" — tlopez-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6276#discussion_r3376076520))
- "If the only difference is the form schema, could this be a shared component that passes the control in as a prop?" — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1010#discussion_r3065363321))

## 2. Dead code, churn & scope creep  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  113 mentions across 7 repos
**What we look for:** Flag unused code/config/deps, leftover references after a rename, commented-out blocks, unnecessary abstractions, and diff noise unrelated to the PR's purpose. Question changes that widen scope beyond the ticket, unintended removals, and "temporary" code with no removal plan. Keep the diff minimal and intentional.
**Examples:**
- "Is this filter needed? since you are already doing `uniqBy` before this" — francof2842, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/946#discussion_r2783642815))
- "I'm seeing a couple .erb files with `FeatureFlag.enabled?(:upIntegration)` still listed. Should these be removed?" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1038#discussion_r3313736567))
- "these probably all have modern equivalent shareable flat configs now and don't need to be defined here" — nickhall, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/916#discussion_r2783530318))

## 3. Type safety & modeling  ·  layer: ts-react  ·  92 mentions across 7 repos
**What we look for:** Flag `any`, unnecessary casts, redundant optional chaining where the type already guarantees presence, numbers where a boolean/enum belongs, and `optional` vs `nullable` confusion. Prefer `import type`, explicit return types, enums over arbitrary strings, and types that encode the real domain invariants. Push weak shapes toward stronger models.
**Examples:**
- "This should probably be a boolean. Can we update the serializer to return a boolean if it's currently returning a number?" — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/931#discussion_r2755043654))
- "Why is it `props?.`? I think typescript already guarantees it is always defined at this point" — francof2842, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/219#discussion_r2943656848))
- "Should this be `import type`?" — tlopez-im, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/229#discussion_r2984940388))

## 4. Naming, wording & typos  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  90 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag vague or overly generic names (`call`, `dag`, generic model names), names that leak implementation details, inconsistent naming conventions, incomplete renames, and typos in identifiers/copy/labels. Names should be descriptive, domain-appropriate, and consistent with existing conventions in the repo.
**Examples:**
- "I'd maybe rename this as `RetailerTypesService`. Catalog as a term isn't widely used in these projects, so we usually call them services." — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1084#discussion_r3625817446))
- "Any thoughts about the naming of this model? feels a little too generic to me" — francof2842, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6100#discussion_r2804615943))
- "Should this be `total_sales_rate`?" — tlopez-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6188#discussion_r3095256490))

## 5. Layer/boundary separation, encapsulation & architecture  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  79 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag logic in the wrong layer (fat controllers, business logic in components), leaked implementation details across boundaries, tight coupling to external text/form shapes, and cross-repo FE/BE inconsistency. Suggest extracting services/modules, pushing filtering into the query, and designing for the next likely case rather than the one in front of you.
**Examples:**
- "a slightly cleaner separation would be to create a service for much of the logic here." — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/957#discussion_r2861925788))
- "it's an infrastructure/operational concern, so should probably be kept under `src/infrastructure/cache-warming`" — nickhall, mim-dashboard-api ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/mim-dashboard-api/pull/381#discussion_r2819924759))
- "Maybe we can get rid of the filter and access the records directly with the SQL query" — francof2842, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6100#discussion_r2804676077))

## 6. Test coverage & edge cases  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  67 mentions across 7 repos
**What we look for:** Flag new fields/filters/endpoints/branches that ship without a corresponding test, and significant cases (e.g. a report variant, an unauthorized-access path, a duplicate-draft scenario) with no assertion. Ask for the missing spec explicitly and name the case that should be exercised.
**Examples:**
- "I think we also need to update the `campaign_spec` for this new filter?" — francof2842, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/930#pullrequestreview-3730547339))
- "I think we probably need a snapshot test for the flat report with visits as well. It's a significant enough case that we should have a test for it." — cmccormick-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6097#discussion_r2774920485))
- "Might add a separate test asserting a separate valid user can't access another user's request" — tseitz, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6153#discussion_r2961152503))

## 7. Test quality: behavior, fixtures & non-redundancy  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  64 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag tests that assert counts/mocks instead of real behavior, tests at the wrong level (integration testing what belongs in a unit), conditionals in tests, brittle exact-value assertions where a shape check is better, redundant setup already in `before`, and duplicate tests. Since we control the data setup, prefer separate deterministic tests over `if` branches.
**Examples:**
- "we should generally try to avoid `if` in the tests, because we control the data setup... If we want to test the inclusion of visit columns, we should have a separate test." — cmccormick-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6097#discussion_r2774927783))
- "The count only check won't catch if `metrics_type` resolves to nil. Could we do one per expected job with `hash_including(...)` instead?" — francof2842, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6100#discussion_r2804648004))
- "The default is false here so I believe the above tests need to explicitly pass true to get the visitation data" — tseitz, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6082#discussion_r2738633581))

## 8. Magic values to named constants  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  56 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag inline literals — numbers, strings, ids, class names — that carry meaning, and push them into named constants (or extend an existing constant list / static map). Reuse the existing constant rather than re-hardcoding. Naming the value both documents intent and centralizes future changes.
**Examples:**
- "`2` is serving as a magic number here. We should extract that into a constant like `ACCOUNT_MANAGER_LIMIT`." — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/911#discussion_r2738848242))
- "can we put `weekly daily` in a constant like we do for `LOCATION_LIST_SOURCES`" — francof2842, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1068#discussion_r3547736905))
- "I'm guessing there's a reason why retailer_type can't be added to FILTER_COLUMNS?" — Ezra-Bartlett, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1084#discussion_r3625277024))

## 9. Error handling, null safety & silent failures  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  55 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag unhandled error paths, missing null/nil guards, values that could be null without a fallback, and defaults that silently mask a real failure. Ask "can this be null/absent here?" and whether an error is being swallowed vs surfaced/logged. Prefer explicit handling (error boundaries, `?? default`, framework error handling) over silent fallback.
**Examples:**
- "Can we guarantee this user exists?" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1017#discussion_r3112565011))
- "Probably need to add the error handler in here" — francof2842, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/946#discussion_r2783633642))
- "Should we add `?? 0` here like in the previous usage?" — tlopez-im, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/250#discussion_r3024312073))

## 10. API contracts, breaking changes, deploy ordering & migrations  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  53 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag response-shape changes that break consumers without a migration/deploy-ordering plan, missing serializer/API-field updates, non-reversible or seed-data-carrying migrations, and Pact contract gaps. Prefer standardized response envelopes (`Api::Response`), backward-compatible params, schema-only migrations (seed via rake task), and verifying the contract against the provider before merge.
**Examples:**
- "Adding static/seed data to a table shouldn't be done via a DB migration. Migrations should be reserved for schema changes... a rake task." — francof2842, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/912#discussion_r2738936031))
- "we should expect the param to be `reportingCadence` rather than `dailyReportingEnabled`... the boolean field is really only a concern in the UI" — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1075#discussion_r3574712956))
- "Should this have `unsigned: true` following migration 20240409210136 for `advanced_report_dimensions`?" — tlopez-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6186#discussion_r3081476229))

## 11. Lint, tooling, config, CI & deps  ·  layer: repo-specific  ·  50 mentions across 7 repos
**What we look for:** Flag missing/incorrect config, CI step ordering and failing checks, un-bumped chart versions on template changes, unjustified or incompatible dependency changes, disabled lint rules, and generated files that weren't regenerated/formatted. Config should be consistent across environments and match repo conventions (e.g. mise as the tool of record).
**Examples:**
- "we also need to increment the `version` in `Chart.yaml`... any changes within `templates` need to have a new chart version." — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/937#discussion_r2766053945))
- "I'd recommend formally switching to mise as the recommended tool and just removing everything else" — nickhall, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/956#discussion_r2800180671))
- "Should this step be set before the `Deploy artifact` step?" — francof2842, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6170#discussion_r2997126589))

## 12. Simplify logic & conditionals  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  46 mentions across 5 repos
**What we look for:** Flag convoluted conditionals, redundant branches, unnecessary parameters, and code that's harder to read than it needs to be. Suggest ternaries, guard clauses/early returns, and dropping params that aren't needed. Favor readability over cleverness.
**Examples:**
- "Should this be something like this... measurementType={visitationEnabled ? \"rsl_visit\" : \"rsl\"}" — francof2842, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/908#discussion_r2736836052))
- "there is no need to include `pageable` or `locationListFilter`... params = { page, size }; params['name'] = name if name.present?" — rive04, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/910#discussion_r2739500333))
- "you could move this logic into the component so you don't have to pass it in every time" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1072#discussion_r3582782877))

## 13. Split large files & file organization  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  41 mentions across 4 repos
**What we look for:** Flag files/classes/functions/components that have grown too large or do too much, and poor placement/ordering (define types before use, initialize instance vars in the constructor, one component per file). Suggest splitting by feature/concern and drawing clearer boundaries.
**Examples:**
- "This file is also starting to get out of hand... we should look for a way to split up provider states by feature." — cmccormick-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6257#discussion_r3283002700))
- "It feels like `handleExport` is doing too much. Maybe we can refactor to something more modular?" — francof2842, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/209#discussion_r2875570350))
- "Can we define this type at the beginning before the first usage to improve readability?" — tlopez-im, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/241#discussion_r3012658306))

## 14. Input & schema validation  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  32 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag inputs that aren't validated at the boundary and bespoke validation where a shared pattern exists. Prefer zod schema refinements (FE) and standard model/JSON-schema validations (BE); keep FE and BE schemas in sync and use the schema field rather than re-deriving. Validate at system boundaries, fail fast.
**Examples:**
- "I think we have in the zod schema `baseCampaignInfoSchema`, should we limit the `accountManagerIds` in order to display some error?" — francof2842, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/911#discussion_r2738867038))
- "We should probably also add these conditions in a refinement to the zod schema." — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/931#discussion_r2755050842))
- "Should we use the field added to the schema `statisticallySignificant` here?" — tlopez-im, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/310#discussion_r3201894013))

## 15. Documentation accuracy  ·  layer: repo-specific  ·  29 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag docs/CLAUDE.md/sample files that drift from the code, are duplicated, or are too verbose. Keep CLAUDE.md concise (agents-as-skills, import syntax `@FILE.md`, under the recommended line budget), and put human-focused prose in the README, not CLAUDE.md. Update sample env/config files when adding new keys.
**Examples:**
- "Not sure this is really necessary in the CLAUDE file given it's more human focused and listed in the README. Could link to the readme" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1044#discussion_r3404266098))
- "could each of these headers be better suited as skills instead of always being loaded into context?" — nickhall, mim-dashboard-api ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/mim-dashboard-api/pull/417#discussion_r2942740462))
- "Should we add these to the sample file?" — cmccormick-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6128#discussion_r2861844185))

## 16. Test structure & conventions (RSpec / rswag)  ·  layer: ruby-rails  ·  29 mentions across 5 repos
**What we look for:** Flag Rails specs that don't follow team conventions: prefer rswag format for external-facing API tests (and commit the regenerated swagger), keep `describe`/`subject`/`let` structure clean, and name tests for behavior. Watch for shared swagger paths overwriting each other.
**Examples:**
- "Can we use the rswag format for these tests? Especially since these are external facing APIs, it will be useful to have the swagger docs." — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/957#discussion_r2861921435))
- "Since this reuses the same path as the existing non RSL endpoint, I believe it ends up overwriting the original schema in swagger. Could we use a different path" — tlopez-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6199#discussion_r3126427615))

## 17. Comment rot & unnecessary comments  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  28 mentions across 6 repos
**What we look for:** Flag comments that merely restate the code, will go stale, or are longer than the code they describe (a frequent AI-generation tell). Keep comments only where they explain a non-obvious "why". Conversely, ask for a brief comment or ticket reference when a genuinely non-obvious workaround lacks one.
**Examples:**
- "This comment is longer than the method itself and probably not needed as you can read the code directly" — cmccormick-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6276#discussion_r3384213602))
- "things like \"reportId is derived as campaignId * 100\" seem unnecessary as you can just read that. And if it were to change the comment would be stale" — tseitz, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/364#discussion_r3460592142))
- "do we need to keep this comment here?" — francof2842, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6290#discussion_r3384505942))

## 18. Correctness & potential bugs  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  28 mentions across 5 repos
**What we look for:** Flag off-by-one/boundary checks (`> 1` vs `> 0`), missing `return`/control-flow bugs, stale state captured at render, incorrect data/labels, and refactors that change behavior. Trace the actual runtime path and confirm the change reflects real expected behavior, not just a passing test.
**Examples:**
- "these locations are captured once at render, so if the user navigates to a new pixel package you will receive old ID's from the url" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1017#discussion_r3112675195))
- "We are probably missing a `return` statement in here, or both jobs might get sent" — francof2842, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6100#discussion_r2804572571))
- "I found it odd that the check is `> 1` and not `> 0`... would there be any issue with changing the check?" — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/988#discussion_r3017047151))

## 19. E2E & resilient locators  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  27 mentions across 4 repos
**What we look for:** Flag brittle Playwright/RTL selectors — positional `.nth()`, attribute checks, non-accessible queries — and prefer semantic matchers (`toBeEnabled`/`toBeDisabled`) and role/text-based locators that survive DOM reordering. Decide the right level (E2E vs component test) and make sure E2E passes before prod deploys.
**Examples:**
- "Are we able to use matchers like `toBeEnabled` or `toBeDisabled` rather than checking attributes directly?" — cmccormick-im, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/343#discussion_r3312754501))
- "Is there a special reason for using `.nth()` here? The previous text selector would not break if the component adds or reorders `<p>`." — tlopez-im, lci-e2e-testing ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-e2e-testing/pull/129#discussion_r3120364106))

## 20. Feature flag gating & sync  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  23 mentions across 5 repos
**What we look for:** Flag new behavior that should be gated behind a flag but isn't, flags flipped on prematurely, and rollout/precedence questions (will this immediately appear on another campaign type?). Confirm downstream systems (reporting) support the values, and check FE/BE flag sync mechanisms and per-environment scoping.
**Examples:**
- "Are the new lag options safe to add without a feature flag? i.e. can reporting team support these values today?" — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1070#discussion_r3560196426))
- "This one was actually false, is the intention to enable this?" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/1038#discussion_r3313751912))
- "does this need to run in all environments?" — nickhall, mim-dashboard-api ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/mim-dashboard-api/pull/381#discussion_r2819986936))

## 21. PR & commit hygiene  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  20 mentions across 5 repos
**What we look for:** Flag PRs missing description/context, unjustified changes ("why are we adding this?"), TODOs without a tracking ticket, oversized PRs, and conventional-commit type mismatches (a behavior change is a `fix`, not a `chore` — the type drives the release). Squash noise before merge.
**Examples:**
- "Can you add something to the PR description and ticket explaining the nature/motivation of these changes? I do not have any context here." — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/971#pullrequestreview-3916309137))
- "If the TODO is meant to be solved in a future ticket, we need to add that ticket number to track it as well" — francof2842, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/219#discussion_r2943681542))
- "Should we have AI take care of this TODO now? Might not be too difficult to get implemented" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/980#discussion_r2966869780))

## 22. React data-loading & hooks patterns  ·  layer: ts-react  ·  19 mentions across 4 repos
**What we look for:** Flag debounce/memo recreated each render, `useEffect` used for data loading, hooks that rebuild a `{data,isLoading,error}` subset instead of returning the query result directly, and non-atomic count-then-create races (prefer a DB constraint). Ask whether work should be sync vs an async job.
**Examples:**
- "It seems debounce would be recreated each render and not respect the 500 ms timeout. Might have to memoize" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/946#discussion_r2783712451))
- "the count-then-create isn't atomic, so two concurrent POSTs for the same campaign can both read 0, and both insert... partial unique index" — francof2842, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6228#discussion_r3234829038))
- "Does the CA request take long enough that it needs to be an async job? Or can it be a synchronous request?" — cmccormick-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6224#discussion_r3222570115))

## 23. Immutability / avoid mutation  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  19 mentions across 3 repos
**What we look for:** Flag in-place mutation — `push`, in-place `reverse`, `delete` on params, direct property assignment. Prefer spreading into new arrays/objects and conditional spreads. This is a standing team pattern; mutation is the exception that needs justification.
**Examples:**
- "there shouldn't be any need to delete or otherwise mutate the params." — cmccormick-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6134#discussion_r2874064531))
- "I would generally want to make this immutable... `dimensionTableData.Bottom = [...dimensionTableData.Bottom].reverse();`" — tseitz, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/174#discussion_r2784188447))

## 24. Theme/styling source of truth & UX  ·  layer: ts-react  ·  19 mentions across 3 repos
**What we look for:** Flag hardcoded styles/class names that should come from the theme, one-off styling that diverges from the app's conventions, and UX gaps — disabled elements with no explanation, missing feedback when a limit is reached, unclear disabled-vs-hidden choices. Keep the theme the source of truth and don't let AI pick stylistic choices that clash with product expectations.
**Examples:**
- "we also want something that disables the unselected options when we've reached the limit. Otherwise, a user may be confused... getOptionDisabled=" — cmccormick-im, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/911#discussion_r2738859641))
- "Is this check preferred over an icon?... want to be consistent vs. letting AI choose stylistic things that don't really go with the app" — tseitz, lci-dashboard-frontend ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/lci-dashboard-frontend/pull/349#discussion_r3325497173))

## 25. Performance  ·  layer: cross-cutting  ·  14 mentions across 5 repos
**What we look for:** Flag repeated expensive calls (calling a payload/remote method twice), per-row N+1 queries on index endpoints (was it measured? consider a batch variant), O(n²) allocations in loops, missing debounce on search, and cache keys that omit a versioning input.
**Examples:**
- "list endpoints now run known_partners_for + a publisher_dashboard_controls query for every row. Was this measured...? If not, consider a batch variant" — tlopez-im, ND-Dashboard ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/ND-Dashboard/pull/6266#discussion_r3313483657))
- "this allocates a new array on every insert, with N advertisers... this is N square allocations. I think a push can solve this" — francof2842, mim-dashboard-api ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/mim-dashboard-api/pull/441#discussion_r3131183522))
- "Should we update the `cache_key` to include `product_hash_version`?" — tseitz, BlazingSaddlesUI ([link](https://github.com/NinthDecimal/BlazingSaddlesUI/pull/967#discussion_r2884825274))

## 26. Security & access control  ·  layer: ruby-rails  ·  7 mentions across 2 repos
**What we look for:** Flag client-facing downloads/endpoints without the same access checks as their siblings, missing role gating, globally-applied auth changes that should be opt-in, and logging of raw request bodies on open endpoints (truncate/scrub).
